effect:
Lowers Speed in Trick Room. (Hold)

Room Service is specifically for Trick Room teams. When Trick Room goes up, this item activates and drops your Speed, making you even "faster" under Trick Room's reversed priority.

This is niche but useful for Trick Room sweepers who want to guarantee they move first under Trick Room. It's consumed after use, so plan accordingly. Pairs well with slow powerhouses that want to maximize their Trick Room turns.
